switch_warning.title: Switching writes to your heating system
switch_warning.description:
You enabled switches. From now on Home Assistant can not only read your heating system, but also switch the boiler and the heating circuits off and on.

Please be aware:
- Switching off a heating circuit or the boiler in winter can let rooms cool down. Frost protection remains the responsibility of the heating system, not of Home Assistant.
- Anyone with access to your Home Assistant can operate these switches.
- Switches only appear where your heating system explicitly reports the variable as writable.

You can turn this off again at any time under Configure.

component_not_found.title: Component "{component}" not found
component_not_found.description:
The menu of your ETA heating system contains no values for the component "{component}". Its function block is probably named differently on your controller (expected roles: {fub_names}).

Open **Settings -> Devices & Services -> ETA Heiztechnik Web Service -> Configure** and enter the actual name, or untick the component if your system does not have it.
